metaTitle: Hypixel Bedwars Stats Command for Twitch | ItsBagelBot
metaDesc: Show Hypixel Bedwars stars, wins and FKDR with !bwstats in Twitch chat. Set your Minecraft username for daily sessions and urchin checks.
title: Hypixel Bedwars stats in Twitch chat.
lead: Viewers type !bwstats for your Hypixel Bedwars stars, wins and FKDR, or !daily for stats since the daily reset. Enable the free module and enter your Minecraft username. !sniper and !tag show urchin checks.
howTitle: Link your Minecraft name and try !bwstats.
step1Desc: Switch on Bedwars Stats in the dashboard and enter your Minecraft username as the default player. If it matches your Twitch username, you can leave the field blank.
step2Desc: Anyone can type !bwstats in chat. The bot replies with stars, wins, final kills, FKDR and beds broken for the linked player.
step3Desc: Each command has its own switch and message template in the dashboard. Keep the sessions and checks you want chat to see.
item1Desc: Enter your Minecraft username. When Mojang resolves it, the bot stores your account UUID so lookups can follow the account after a name change.
item2Desc: Viewers can check another player with !bwstats Technoblade or !daily Technoblade. You can restrict lookups to your linked account in the dashboard.
item3Desc: !daily, !weekly and !monthly show wins, losses, final kills, beds broken and FKDR for their respective reset periods.
item4Desc: !sniper returns the urchin score. !tag lists active blacklist tags, and !tagdescription includes their reasons.
limitsNote: The module is off by default. Each command has a 5 second cooldown. Sessions, scores and tags come from urchin.gg.
faqQ1: How do I show my Bedwars stats in Twitch chat?
faqA1: Enable Bedwars Stats in the ItsBagelBot dashboard and enter your Minecraft username as the linked account. Viewers can then type !bwstats to see your stars, wins, final kills, FKDR and beds broken.
faqQ2: Can chat see my daily Bedwars session?
faqA2: Yes. !daily shows wins, losses, final kills, beds broken and FKDR since the daily reset. !weekly and !monthly cover their own reset periods. These periods are separate from your stream session.
faqQ3: Can viewers check other players or snipers?
faqA3: Yes. Try !sniper Technoblade for the urchin score or !tag Technoblade for active blacklist tags. !tagdescription Technoblade includes tag reasons. You can restrict player lookups to your linked account.
faqQ4: Is it free, and what if I change my Minecraft name?
faqA4: Yes. Bedwars Stats is included in the free plan. When Mojang resolves your username, the bot stores the account UUID so linked-account lookups can follow a name change.
faqQ5: Where does the data come from?
faqA5: Lifetime stats from !bwstats use the official Hypixel API. Daily, weekly and monthly sessions, urchin scores and blacklist tags come from urchin.gg.
legal: ItsBagelBot is not affiliated with or endorsed by Hypixel, Mojang Studios or Microsoft.
tblNote: These replies use the default templates with sample values. Lifetime stats use Hypixel data; sessions and checks use urchin.gg.
demoTitle: Checking lifetime stats and the daily session.
prereq1: Enable Bedwars Stats in the dashboard. The module is off by default.
prereq2: Your Minecraft username for the default player, with Hypixel Bedwars data.
